about: Typical games missed for players who land on the weekly injury report (not IR). 'study' rows are backed by NFL research; 'estimate' rows are FFD estimates from general sports-medicine ranges. Edit numbers or notes here; the injury job picks them up on its next run.

injuries.note: About a third of NFL hamstring strains recur, and players who come back within two weeks carry the highest re-injury risk.
injuries.source: Jenkins et al., Orthop J Sports Med 2024; Bodendorfer et al., Phys Sportsmed 2023

injuries.note: NFL players missed a median of 9 days after a concussion. 59% missed at least one game, and only 38% concussed on a Sunday played the next Sunday.
injuries.source: Return to Full Participation Following Concussion in the NFL, 2015-2020 (Clin J Sport Med 2022)

injuries.note: Low ankle sprains often cost 0-1 games. High ankle sprains averaged about two weeks in NFL data and can run much longer.
injuries.source: Syndesmotic ankle injuries in NFL and NHL athletes (PMC8822069)

injuries.note: 'Knee' covers everything from a bruise to a torn ligament. Most MCL sprains cost 2-6 weeks; ACL tears go straight to IR.
injuries.source: Dr. Matthew Matava, NFL Physicians Society (NFL.com)

injuries.note: Calf strains took about 2.5 weeks to return from in one NFL team's data, and they tend to linger.
injuries.source: Acute Gastrocnemius-Soleus Complex Injuries in NFL Athletes (PMC5298443)

injuries.note: Mild midfoot sprains cost NFL players about 3 days; moderate ones about 5 weeks.
injuries.source: Midfoot sprains in the National Football League (Am J Sports Med 2014)

injuries.note: Groin strains often limit cutting for a week or two. Core muscle surgery usually means IR.
Thigh bruises usually cost little time; true quad strains behave more like hamstrings.
On a weekly report this is usually soreness or tendinitis. A tear ends the season.
Turf toe and heel issues often linger and sap burst even when the player suits up.
Trunk and hip injuries are usually played through, but they can cap snaps.
Stingers usually clear in days. Neck injuries that need imaging can mean IR.
AC sprains are often played through with padding. Dislocations tend to recur.
Rib injuries are painful but often played through with a flak jacket. Pec tears go to IR.
Skill players usually play with a wrap or cast. It matters more for a QB's throwing hand.
Most illnesses cost a practice or two, rarely a game.

fallback.note: Team hasn't said what the injury is, or it doesn't match our table yet.
